agent_assessment:
All 24 new tests pass across all 3 new test files and the 2 additions to stripe_concurrent_test.go. Implementation matches the plan's Definition of Done closely:

1. E2E happy path (checkout -> webhook -> entitlement -> download): PASS
2. E2E Stripe API error propagation: PASS
3. Out-of-order webhook delivery (invoice.paid before checkout, subscription.updated before checkout): PASS
4. Email change interleaved with payment: PASS
5. User deleted between checkout and webhook: PASS
6. Full 8-status subscription matrix (active, past_due, canceled, unpaid, incomplete, incomplete_expired, trialing, paused): ALL PASS
7. Lifecycle transitions (active->canceled, canceled->resubscribed, active->past_due->active, trial expired): ALL PASS
8. Entitlement error propagation (fail-closed): PASS
9. Intro coupon lifecycle (apply -> use -> reject reuse): PASS
10. Email variant bypass blocked: PASS
11. Expired coupon rejection: PASS
12. Concurrent email migration + payment webhook: PASS
13. Concurrent subscription status change during download auth: PASS

Shared monetizationTestHarness is implemented with signWebhookPayload (HMAC-SHA256), fireWebhook, seedGatedAsset helpers.

GCT test failures (4/11) are all pre-existing and unrelated to this work: go vet lock-copy warnings in landing_config_service.go (protobuf structs), UI standards violations (BrowserRouter basename), a flaky unit test (daysSinceUpdate off-by-one), and missing playbook results.
notes: All 24 new tests pass consistently - no flakiness observed
go vet warnings are pre-existing (protobuf lock-copy in landing_config_service.go), not introduced by this work
GCT 4 failures are all pre-existing: lint (protobuf lock-copy), standards (BrowserRouter basename x11, tsconfig x3), unit (daysSinceUpdate off-by-one timing), playbooks (no results)
monetizationTestHarness correctly bundles StripeService + AccountService + DownloadAuthorizer + test DB with HMAC-SHA256 webhook signing
download_entitlement_integration_test.go disables AccountService cache (cacheTTL=0) to ensure status changes are immediately visible in lifecycle tests

improvement_suggestions.description: Add the 24 new test functions to the GCT integration test phase so they are tracked in automated quality metrics. Currently GCT runs 11 phases; the new tests pass but may not be counted in GCT's test dimension.

Fix the pre-existing go vet lock-copy warnings in landing_config_service.go (9 violations) by using pointer receivers for protobuf types containing sync.Mutex. This is the primary contributor to GCT's red code quality dimension.
Fix flaky unit test in downloads-workflow.test.ts (daysSinceUpdate 44 vs 45 off-by-one). This is a timing-dependent assertion that will intermittently fail near day boundaries.
